title: UI operability contract with acceptance gates

claims.text: The Acceptance requirements table defines gates O1 through O14 with headless verification and rejecting contrasts.
The Routes table fixes data-lin-screen values, visible h1 text and subordinate headings for agents, agent, lineage, arena, bench and ledger routes.
The Accessible identity keys section defines key derivation from full identity or truncated hash and the Identity key collision stop rule.
The Complete action registry lists shell, agents, agent-detail, lineage, arena, benchmark and ledger actions with elements and accessible names.

decision.rule: Change here when operability gates, routes, selector vocabulary, identity keys or the action registry needs to change.
decision.failure: A screen violates a gate (missing heading, non-native control, colliding names) or a selector activates another record.

questions.q: Where does the operability contract define the acceptance gate for keyboard-complete dialogs?
Where should I change the accessible name budget or identity key derivation?
Where can I debug why a data-lin-action selector resolves to no control or many controls?
Where does the contract specify the Lineage screen heading and actions?
